sources.title: Gatekeeper replicating data
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: PEP610：直接URL來源、不可變commit與安裝證據
related.titleEn: PEP 610: direct URL origins, immutable commits and installed evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算，缺資料不自動允許；報告清楚限制快取模型對並行唯一性的能力。 交付gatekeeper-inventory.csv、GVK同步契約與並行反例；不對真實叢集執行變更。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 75 and 90 percent, never turn missing data into implicit permission, and clearly limit what the cache model can establish about concurrent uniqueness. Deliver gatekeeper-inventory.csv, the GVK synchronization contract and a concurrent-admission counterexample without changing an actual cluster.
related.difference: 建立10份安裝來源描述，分VCS、archive與local directory；對VCS列完整commit，對archive列核准摘要，editable安裝另外標示可變。
related.differenceEn: Build ten installed-origin descriptors covering VCS, archives and local directories. Record complete commits for VCS, approved digests for archives and explicit mutability for editable installations, preserving the distinct schema shapes rather than forcing every origin into one field.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課以已同步且版本符合物件數衡量覆蓋率；同步通常有延遲，100%當下覆蓋也不保證之後兩個並行准入不競爭。 20個預期物件中15個已進入正確inventory路徑且版本相符，5個缺失或過期；固定GVK與namespace範圍。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；補同步其中3個後為18/20×100=90%，另2個仍需保留未決。
本課穩定來源覆蓋要求能連到已核准不可變來源；branch/tag只是請求名稱，commit_id是解析版本。來源中繼資料本身不是已安裝位元組的簽章。 10份中6份有完整且核准的不可變來源，2份僅分支名稱、2份editable目錄；本課將後四份列為未滿足固定來源政策。 穩定來源覆蓋6/10×100=60%；補齊一份分支安裝的實際核准commit後為7/10×100=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure coverage as objects synchronized at the expected revision. Synchronization has delay, and even full coverage at one instant does not prove that two subsequent concurrent admissions cannot race; this is an observation metric, not a transactional uniqueness guarantee. Fifteen of 20 expected objects occupy the correct inventory paths with matching revisions. Five are missing or stale. Fix the GVK and namespace scope so excluded kinds are not silently treated as successful synchronization. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Synchronizing three more gives 18/20×100=90 percent, leaving two unresolved; the increase does not establish a global freshness guarantee.

Stable-origin coverage requires an approved immutable source association. Branches and tags are requested names while commit_id identifies the resolved revision. Origin metadata is not itself a signature over the currently installed filesystem bytes. Six of ten descriptors have complete approved immutable origins, two retain only branch names and two point to editable directories. The latter four do not satisfy the fixed-origin policy selected for this release exercise. Stable-origin coverage is 6/10×100=60 percent. Recording and approving the actual commit for one branch-origin installation raises it to 7/10×100=70 percent, without making editable directories immutable.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Elasticsearch：PIT搜尋分頁與鑑識匯出重現性
related.titleEn: Elasticsearch: PIT pagination and reproducible forensic exports
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算，缺資料不自動允許；報告清楚限制快取模型對並行唯一性的能力。 交付gatekeeper-inventory.csv、GVK同步契約與並行反例；不對真實叢集執行變更。

Deliver gatekeeper-inventory.csv, the GVK synchronization contract and a concurrent-admission counterexample without changing an actual cluster.
related.difference: 使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。
related.differenceEn: Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課以已同步且版本符合物件數衡量覆蓋率；同步通常有延遲，100%當下覆蓋也不保證之後兩個並行准入不競爭。 20個預期物件中15個已進入正確inventory路徑且版本相符，5個缺失或過期；固定GVK與namespace範圍。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；補同步其中3個後為18/20×100=90%，另2個仍需保留未決。
匯出完整性需同時檢查唯一數與預期集合；總行數正確仍可能由重複與遺漏互相抵消。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 預期1000個ID，匯出每頁100列共10頁；跨頁漂移使20個ID重複且20個預期ID缺席。 檔案仍1000列，但唯一ID只有980，預期覆蓋980/1000=98%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure coverage as objects synchronized at the expected revision. Synchronization has delay, and even full coverage at one instant does not prove that two subsequent concurrent admissions cannot race; this is an observation metric, not a transactional uniqueness guarantee. Fifteen of 20 expected objects occupy the correct inventory paths with matching revisions. Five are missing or stale. Fix the GVK and namespace scope so excluded kinds are not silently treated as successful synchronization. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Synchronizing three more gives 18/20×100=90 percent, leaving two unresolved; the increase does not establish a global freshness guarantee.

Export completeness requires unique counts and expected-set comparison; duplicate and missing rows can cancel in total counts. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Expect 1000 IDs across ten pages of one hundred rows; pagination drift duplicates twenty IDs and omits twenty expected IDs. The file still contains 1000 rows, but only 980 unique expected IDs, producing 98% coverage.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
